### CVE-2015-0569
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2016-05-09 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 39308: Linux Kernel 3.x/4.x - prima WLAN Driver Heap Overflow (dos/linux, 2016-01-25, verified=0)

Heap-based buffer overflow in the private wireless extensions IOCTL implementation in wlan_hdd_wext.c in the WLAN (aka Wi-Fi) driver for the Linux kernel 3.x and 4.x, as used in Qualcomm Innovation Center (QuIC) Android contributions for MSM devices and other products, allows attackers to gain privileges via a crafted application that establishes a packet filter.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2015-1328
- Assigner: canonical | Published: 2016-11-28 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 40688: Linux Kernel (Ubuntu / Fedora / RedHat) - 'Overlayfs' Local Privilege Escalation (Metasploit) (local/linux, 2016-11-02, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 37292: Linux Kernel 3.13.0 < 3.19 (Ubuntu 12.04/14.04/14.10/15.04) - 'overlayfs' Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2015-06-16, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 37293: Linux Kernel 3.13.0 < 3.19 (Ubuntu 12.04/14.04/14.10/15.04) - 'overlayfs' Local Privilege Escalation (Access /etc/shadow) (local/linux, 2015-06-16, verified=1)

The overlayfs implementation in the linux (aka Linux kernel) package before 3.19.0-21.21 in Ubuntu through 15.04 does not properly check permissions for file creation in the upper filesystem directory, which allows local users to obtain root access by leveraging a configuration in which overlayfs is permitted in an arbitrary mount namespace.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2015-3036
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2015-05-21 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 38566: NetUSB - Kernel Stack Buffer Overflow (dos/hardware, 2015-10-29, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 38454: Linux/MIPS Kernel 2.6.36 - 'NetUSB' Remote Code Execution (remote/multiple, 2015-10-14, verified=0)

Stack-based buffer overflow in the run_init_sbus function in the KCodes NetUSB module for the Linux kernel, as used in certain NETGEAR products, TP-LINK products, and other products, allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by providing a long computer name in a session on TCP port 20005.

### CVE-2015-3214
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2015-08-31 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 37990: QEMU - Programmable Interrupt Timer Controller Heap Overflow (dos/multiple, 2015-08-27, verified=1)

The pit_ioport_read in i8254.c in the Linux kernel before 2.6.33 and QEMU before 2.3.1 does not distinguish between read lengths and write lengths, which might allow guest OS users to execute arbitrary code on the host OS by triggering use of an invalid index.

### CVE-2015-3290
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2015-08-31 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 37722: Linux Kernel - 'espfix64' Nested NMIs Interrupting Privilege Escalation (local/linux_x86-64, 2015-08-05, verified=0)

arch/x86/entry/entry_64.S in the Linux kernel before 4.1.6 on the x86_64 platform improperly relies on espfix64 during nested NMI processing, which allows local users to gain privileges by triggering an NMI within a certain instruction window.

### CVE-2015-7566

- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 39540: Linux Kernel 3.10.0 (CentOS / RHEL 7.1) - visor clie_5_attach Nullpointer Dereference (dos/linux, 2016-03-09, verified=0)

### CVE-2015-8104
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2015-11-16 | Updated: 2025-04-23 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: n/a
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The KVM subsystem in the Linux kernel through 4.2.6, and Xen 4.3.x through 4.6.x, allows guest OS users to cause a denial of service (host OS panic or hang) by triggering many #DB (aka Debug) exceptions, related to svm.c.

### CVE-2015-8660
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2015-12-28 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 40688: Linux Kernel (Ubuntu / Fedora / RedHat) - 'Overlayfs' Local Privilege Escalation (Metasploit) (local/linux, 2016-11-02, verified=1)

- Exploit-DB 39230: Linux Kernel 4.3.3 - 'overlayfs' Local Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2016-01-12, verified=0)

The ovl_setattr function in fs/overlayfs/inode.c in the Linux kernel through 4.3.3 attempts to merge distinct setattr operations, which allows local users to bypass intended access restrictions and modify the attributes of arbitrary overlay files via a crafted application.

### CVE-2015-8963
- Assigner: google_android | Published: 2016-11-16 | Updated: 2024-10-15 | Max CVSS: 7
- CWE: n/a; CWE-362 CWE-362 Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition'); CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Race condition in kernel/events/core.c in the Linux kernel before 4.4 allows local users to gain privileges or cause a denial of service (use-after-free) by leveraging incorrect handling of an swevent data structure during a CPU unplug operation.
